# Curriculum Vitae

::: lead
Mobility researcher specialising in active travel, spatial analysis and urban planning.

## Current position

### Postdoctoral Researcher in Urban Planning and Mobility

<span class="cv-institution">Department of Geography, Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona</span>  
<span class="cv-date">Barcelona, Spain · December 2024–present</span>

- Researcher in the **ATRAPA** (*The Active Travel Backlash Paradox*) project.
- Spatial analysis of active-travel interventions and public response.
- Development and validation of spatial datasets.
- Collaborative research within GEMOTT.

## Previous employment

### Research Fellow in Active Travel and Road Safety Data Science

<span class="cv-institution">Institute for Transport Studies, University of Leeds</span>  
<span class="cv-date">Leeds, United Kingdom · April 2022–March 2024</span>

- Research on the **SATURN** and **CRUSE** projects in active travel and cycling planning.
- Road lighting, cycling demand modelling and spatial analysis.
- Co-supervision of MSc students.
